features: NO DATABASE CHANGES — No migrations. Three changes of behaviour: reversing an invoice that sits in an instalment plan; in the plan that finances invoices, the period declared on the invoice now decides on an ordinary management too; the period becomes mandatory for new prior-year invoices with a part not covered by the opening balances.

REVERSING AN INVOICE THAT SITS IN AN INSTALMENT PLAN — Reversal did not look at plans: the cancelled invoice stayed in its plan and the instalments kept charging it. Now editing, deleting and reversing follow one rule. Until the plan has collected anything, the invoice first leaves the plan (delete a draft plan, send an approved one back to draft, cancel the issued instalments) and the plan's other invoices become available again. If the plan has already collected, reversal is still allowed and the confirmation warns that the instalments stay and that what was paid must be refunded or allocated by a resolution. A plan that already holds a reversed invoice is not recalculated: it stops and names it.

«NOT ALLOWED» ITEMS CAN BE READ — In the invoice list, «Delete — not allowed» and «Reverse — not allowed» can be clicked and open the reason with the way out: the hover hint never appeared. Creating a plan refuses an invoice reversed in the meantime.

IN AN INVOICE PLAN THE INVOICE'S PERIOD DECIDES, ON ORDINARY MANAGEMENT TOO — The plan that finances off-budget invoices, on an ordinary management, split the expense over the days of the financial year and ignored the declared period. Now the declared period decides, both in the engine and in the sale adjustment: a 2025 prior-year invoice of € 1,200.00 with the deed on 1 May used to be an adjustment pair of € 5.48 with eight draft instalments moved to the buyer; now it all belongs to the seller and the drafts stay with them. An unexpected expense from 1 March to 31 August is split 61 days to the seller and 123 to the buyer.

THE PERIOD OF PRIOR-YEAR INVOICES BECOMES MANDATORY — A prior-year invoice with a part not covered by the opening balances cannot be recorded without the period in which the cost accrued, ending before the financial year in which you record it: it could not be added later, because a prior-year invoice is reversed, not edited. Fully covered, it stays optional.

PRIOR-YEAR INVOICES ALREADY RECORDED WITHOUT A PERIOD ARE NOT GUESSED — The cart flags them and says what the allocation will do (on ordinary management the days of this year, on extraordinary the resolution date, with «Urgency» a stop), and also flags those with a period inside the financial year. The plan stops, explains the remedy and asks for a note; the invoice is recognisable by supplier and amount, and its number opens the details with a link.
PLAN CREATION SHOWS THE SERVER'S REFUSALS — A stopped generation or a management without a chart of accounts said nothing: now the reason appears next to «Save instalment plan».

IN THE INVOICE FORM — The «no edits inside an approved plan» rule checks all of the invoice's plans. The budget analysis no longer shows «+€ -282.00» in green and says «Remaining». The period options are stacked; in the cart, on a phone, the amount moves below the text.

ALSO FIXED — The acknowledgement note could be skipped with a hand-built request; in a sale adjustment two direct charges on the same unit merged into a single item; period dates written in European format were compared as text; malformed coverages caused a server error.

LIMITS — How to adjust a plan that has already collected for an invoice later reversed will be decided with the year-end statement. With amounts already paid by both the person and the unit, the adjustment and the engine differ by a few euros, as before this version. The dark theme of the invoice cart is still to be fixed.
